people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “I will put my name in Jerusalem.”
translations.bsb: Manasseh also built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD had said, “In Jerusalem I will put My Name.”
translations.kjv: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
translations.asv: And he built altars in the house of Jehovah, whereof Jehovah said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
